{{Top|canon=Filla-foam}}
'''Emergency patching foam''' was a substance that could be used to seal [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]] breaches in the hulls of [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. [[YVH 2-4S]] and [[YVH 2-1S]] used some aboard the ''[[Exquisite Death]]'' during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

*''[[The New Jedi Order: Star by Star]]'' {{1st}}
